adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` returns nil it unconditionally calls `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)` and renders `embed/loading` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). The `loading.html.erb` view contains a `setTimeout` that reloads the page every 30s, so a page that never successfully creates an embed will keep re-requesting `/embed/best` and enqueue a new `RetrieveTopic` job each time. Although `TopicRetriever` throttles actual retrieval work inside the job via Redis (`retrieved_recently?`), the controller still enqueues jobs repeatedly, which can spam the job queue indefinitely for a stuck/invalid embed_url.
